description: Closes the browser, checks every captured hit against the plan (missing events, missing parameters, duplicates, hits before consent, Consent Mode defaults, emails sent in plain text, unplanned events) and writes the report with the event timeline. Returns the findings. The plan is what should be tracked: pass a saved one with against, or write one inline with measurement_plan.

against.description: A saved plan to check against: latest (or last), first, a plan ID such as 2026-10-16_0627, or on a local server a path to a plan file or folder. Plans are the ones saved by `aitd plan --site <url>`. The site comes from this audit. Use either against or measurement_plan, not both.

branding.description: Set false to leave the Analitik İşler logo and credit line out of the report.

completed.description: Whether the journey reached its goal.

events.description: Only check these events, e.g. ["purchase", "add_to_cart"]. On your own journey, these events are also expected to fire.

measurement_plan.description: The plan (what should be tracked) as JSON text, e.g. {"consent_mode": true, "events": [{"platform": "ga4", "name": "purchase", "required_params": ["transaction_id", "value", "currency"]}]}. On a local server this can also be a file path. Without a plan, a ready-made journey checks its own events; otherwise only consent, duplicate and personal data checks run.

note.description: One sentence on how the journey ended.

name: finish_audit
title: Finish and check the audit
